reviews.title: The app is good when the sound works
reviews.text: It’s so frustrating to spend money and effort on an app and the sound rarely works. Not even on my phone.  So then I deleted the app and reinstalled.  Same problem.  It only intermittently  works on the device I didn’t update.  Please fix this.  It’s ridiculous.

reviews.title: Is this math seeds or reading eggs? I’m confused?
reviews.text: When you have an autistic child you shouldn’t have to worry about them using one application that then takes them to another application and lets then create a dual account ( hide my email address) no parent should have to worry about security with their ten year old child, and no parent should be told that they don’t have permission to see a message that was supposedly posted by them, when a parent seeks out help for a special needs child they shouldn’t have to worry about someone else gaining access to the account within one day of the account created and restrictions were set but somehow this application and mathseeds allowed bypassing restrictions. reviews.title: We love this, but…

It then turns into a day that we don’t use the app, which is a shame. Please fix this!

reviews.title: Fish, math, problem, not working
reviews.text: Hi. I am having an issue on the number 10 where it is wanting me to do a math problem with 10 fish. I put the fish into the bucket with no problem. Then I go to the next step which is to drag them to each character and I can’t give them to the other character because when I give the fish to Ruby or try to, it makes a BOING sound at me and refuses to go in. but yet I give the fish to mango with no problem. I am blind and autistic and don’t like having to skip lessons because of issues like this, but I feel like I’m going to have to do that since this is having a technical issue. It was so bad that one of my staff that tried to help at the place that I go to during the day could not help me. Her and I both had the same problem. Please help. another suggestion I would have is to put a hint button in the activities for when people are having trouble. That way if they’re stuck, they can get a hint. I feel like that would be really helpful.

reviews.title: Excellent for Struggling Learners
reviews.text: Reading Eggs has been an integral part of my daughter’s learning.  She has a severe case of dyslexia and retention of skills has been a struggle.  Decoding is exhausting for her even though she has known the phonograms and basics of phonetics and syllabication.  Reading Eggs has been great in the aspect of flexibility and repetition, which is what a learner like her needs. Our top things that we like about this program is that we can adjust the level at any point and review as much as necessary, the program is multifaceted, it provides printable worksheets to go along with the lessons and although it is still whimsical it is not completely voiced for just younger children.

reviews.title: Excellent curriculum!
reviews.text: My 7 year old autistic son LOVES Reading Eggs! He loves the hands on, game like engaging fun! He’s a very independent learner and enjoys doing his lessons and all that the app has to offer. As a Master Reading Teacher & Reading Specialist certified teacher, I’m pleased with the content and how it teaches. So many programs just read aloud (or have the kid read independently) sentences and paragraphs and then asks questions. That’s a quiz, assessing comprehension. It’s not teaching! Thank you for being a solid program that teaches engaging lessons in a way that fosters problem solving and critical thinking. Highly recommend for self led learners! Or even to do side by side with help.

reviews.title: Love this app!

reviews.title: Homeschool recommended family approved
reviews.text: I was skeptical at first, but I love how the kids daily reads are logged automatically once they finish books. It tracks their progress as well as making it super easy to understand where the kids are in terms of reading and math levels. Easy to navigate and they have TONS of printouts available which is really awesome. The kids love “playing” with reading eggs as well. Before class begins our routine is to “play” before class begins which wakes them up and gets them ready for class as well as gets them ahead for the day with their assignments 🥰 I’m a happy momma for sure !
